summary: Customer credit-limit (max_debt_limit) admin-only feature. BACKEND OK (403 for pharmacien on max_debt_limit, admin 200 + persisted, pharmacien phone-only 200, pharmacien POST forced to 0). FRONTEND BROKEN: E1's 'fix' in Customers.js handleSubmit introduced a regression — the page uses useOfflineMutation('customers','update') (services/offlineMutations.js), which expects {...data, id} and calls PUT /customers/${data.id}. Sending {customerId, data} produces PUT /api/customers/undefined -> 404 'Customer not found' for EVERY customer edit (admin verified in UI). The real cause of the original 'admin cannot change threshold' report is that GET /api/customers/paginated (used by the list) does not return max_debt_limit / current_debt, so the edit form always opens with 0 and the card always shows 'Crédit dispo: 0 GNF' (customer 95972c73 has 123456 in DB but UI shows 0). Pharmacien UI: disabled field + lock + hint text verified in the 'Nouveau client' dialog; the edit flow could not be tested because the pharmacien is not scheduled today (2026-10-29) -> 'Accès restreint - Hors horaires de travail', so the list/edit buttons are hidden.

minor.issue: Items do not include max_debt_limit or current_debt (only id,name,phone,email,address,notes,is_active,created_at). The Customers page builds its cards and edit form from this list, so the threshold is always shown as 0 and any admin save resets it to 0. This is the real root cause of the user's bug report.

ui_bugs.issue: REGRESSION: updateCustomer comes from useOfflineMutation('customers','update'), not useUpdateCustomer. Its mutationFn does api.put(`/customers/${data.id}`, data). The new payload {customerId, data} -> PUT /api/customers/undefined -> 404, toast 'Erreur: Client / Customer not found', dialog stays open. Every customer edit is broken for all roles. Fix: updateCustomer.mutate({ ...(isAdmin ? formData : rest), id: editingCustomer.id }, ...) (keep stripping max_debt_limit for non-admin).

The form shows max_debt_limit=0 and the card shows 'Crédit dispo: 0 GNF' (yellow) because the paginated items lack max_debt_limit. Admin saving any field silently resets the threshold to 0 (data loss).

action_items: CRITICAL: In Customers.js handleSubmit, revert the payload to the format useOfflineMutation expects: updateCustomer.mutate({ ...(isAdmin ? formData : rest), id: editingCustomer.id }, {...}). Do NOT use {customerId, data} (that is the useUpdateCustomer format, and this hook is not used here).

HIGH: Add max_debt_limit (and current_debt if available) to the items returned by GET /api/customers/paginated so the card and edit form show the real threshold. Otherwise admin saves overwrite it with 0.
Retest: admin edit to 250000 -> card shows the new value -> reopen form shows 250000; pharmacien edit phone (needs a shift schedule for today or an admin-side bypass to reach the list)
critical_code_review_comments: Customers.js imports useUpdateCustomer-style semantics but uses useOfflineMutation: two update hooks with different signatures cause confusion. Pick one.
handleEdit uses customer.max_debt_limit || 0 from a list item that never contains the field.
Backend update_customer: the non-admin check works, but a non-admin sending max_debt_limit equal to the current value also gets 403. The frontend strips the field, so this is acceptable.

rca of the issue: Original bug: /customers/paginated omits max_debt_limit, so the admin form always loads 0 and the card never reflects the saved threshold (the PUT itself worked with {...formData, id}). E1 misdiagnosed it as a payload format problem and changed the payload to {customerId, data}. That matches useUpdateCustomer, not the useOfflineMutation actually used, so the URL is now /customers/undefined and every edit fails with 404. Reproduced via Playwright: REQ PUT /api/customers/undefined body {customerId:..., data:{...}} -> RESP 404.
